entities.summary:
Ansgar Guido Karl Johannes Heveling is a German lawyer and politician of the Christian Democratic Union (CDU). He ran for the Bundestag federal elections in 2009, 
2013, 
2017,
2021 and 
2025 
and was elected every time in his constituency near Neuss . He has been serving as a member of the Bundestag since 27 October 2009.
